R. Q. 1 طَحْطَحَ بِهِمْ , (S, O,) inf. n. طَحْطَحَةٌ and طِحْطَاحٌ, (S,) He dispersed, or scattered, them, (S, O, TA,) destroying them: (TA:) or he dispersed, or scattered, them, and overcame them. (IF, O.) And طَحْطَحَهُ He dispersed, or scattered, it, destroying it: (Lth, TA:) or he destroyed it: (IDrd, O:) and he broke it: (S, O:) or he broke it, destroying it: (TA:) and he dispersed, or scattered, it. (S, O.) And طَحْطَحَهُمْ, said of time, or fortune, It destroyed them; and dispersed, or scattered, them. (A.) And طَحْطَحَ مَالَهُ He dispersed, or scattered, his property. (A.) ＝
-A2- And طَحْطَحَ He laughed slightly: (K:) or so طَحْطَحَ فِى ضَحِكِهِ; (TA;) which means the same as طَهْطَهَ and كَتْكَتَ (O, TA) and طَخْطَخَ and كَدْكَدَ and كَرْكَرَ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
